req.title: Return POST request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to POST /post with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that POST /post returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with form data, (2) verify JSON body payload reflection, (3) verify query-string args reflection, (4) test the negative path with a wrong HTTP method (GET on /post), (5) test boundary of empty body, and (6) test exact key set presence. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximize mutation kill rate.

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_method_on_post_endpoint_returns_405():
    r = client.get('/post')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 404

tests.name: test_post_empty_body_boundary_all_keys_present_and_empty
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with completely empty body and no content-type
expected: All 8 required keys present: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: boundary of empty POST body
R-HTTPBIN-004: all keys present even with no payload
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_empty_body_boundary_all_keys_present_and_empty():
    r = client.post('/post', data=b'', content_type='application/octet-stream')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['args'] == {}
    assert body['files'] == {}
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert len(body['url']) > 0
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert len(body['headers']) > 0

test_post_empty_body_boundary_all_keys_present_and_empty()

tests.name: test_post_url_field_contains_post_path
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: url field is a string containing '/post'
origin field is a non-empty string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: url field reflects request URL
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_url_field_contains_post_path():
    r = client.post('/post', data={'a': '1'},
                    content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert '/post' in body['url']
    assert isinstance(body['origin'], str)
    assert len(body['origin']) > 0
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert 'Content-Type' in body['headers'] or 'content-type' in body['headers']
    assert body['form'] == {'a': '1'}

test_post_url_field_contains_post_path()

tests.name: test_post_exact_key_count_no_extra_no_missing
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Response JSON has exactly 8 keys (not 7, not 9)
No extra keys beyond the required 8
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: exactly the 8 specified keys returned
tests.executable:
import json as _json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_exact_key_count_no_extra_no_missing():
    r = client.post('/post',
                    data=_json.dumps({'x': 1}),
                    content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert len(body) == 8
    assert len(body) != 7
    assert len(body) != 9
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert 'method' not in body

test_post_exact_key_count_no_extra_no_missing()

tests.name: test_post_put_method_does_not_hit_post_handler
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put is a separate endpoint from POST /post
actions: Send PUT request to /post (wrong method for this endpoint)
trace: NEG: PUT method rejected by POST-only endpoint
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_put_method_does_not_hit_post_handler():
    r = client.put('/post', data='body')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 500

test_post_put_method_does_not_hit_post_handler()
